integrity: The adjacency criterion is independently reconstructed from the published Schur-cover commutator formula. The clique bound and equality classification are proved by Smith normal form over Z/p^aZ, and the exact count is obtained from GL_2-orbit stabilizers. Finite enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to homocyclic rank-two finite abelian p-groups.
It determines maximum cliques but not chromatic number.
A 2026 direct-product article was available only at abstract level in the inspected interface.
An equivalent isotropic-submodule statement may exist under finite-chain-ring terminology.
